description: Simulated multi-turn conversation scenarios for Home Credit Loan Against Property (LAP) Voice Agent. Clearly labeled as simulated conversational test data.

scenarios.name: Fully Eligible Salaried Customer
scenarios.description: Customer answers all seven checklist items with full eligibility.
customer_utterances: Yes, speaking. How can I help you?
Yeah sure, I have a couple of minutes. What offer is this?
Sounds interesting. Yes, I would like to explore this loan against property.
It's a residential apartment in Gurgaon.
It is solely in my own name.
Yes, I have all the original registry and chain documents safe in my bank locker.
I am looking for around 50 lakhs.
I work as a senior software engineer in an IT firm, salaried, and my salary comes directly to my HDFC bank account.
The current market value of the flat is approximately 95 lakhs.
I want to repay it comfortably over 10 years.

scenarios.name: Agricultural Property Disqualification
scenarios.description: Customer owns agricultural farmland which triggers immediate disqualification.
customer_utterances: Haan ji, Suresh bol raha hoon.
Haan batao, do minute hain mere paas.
Haan bilkul, sunna chahta hoon kya offer hai.
Dekho mere paas gaon mein 5 acre agricultural farmland hai kheti ke liye.

scenarios.name: Cash Income Disqualification
scenarios.description: Customer receives income purely in cash, triggering immediate disqualification.
customer_utterances: Yes, I am looking for funds.
It is a commercial shop in the main market.
Yes, original deed documents are ready.
I run a local grocery business and collect all my profit strictly in cash, no bank account deposit.

scenarios.name: Loan Cap Exceeded (90L) and Accepted (75L)
scenarios.description: Customer requests 90 Lakhs, is informed of the 75 Lakh cap, agrees to proceed, and qualifies.
customer_utterances: Yes, I might need some capital.
Yes, we have all original documents at home.
Actually, I need 90 lakhs for my business expansion.
Okay, 75 lakhs works for now. Let's proceed with 75 lakhs.
Self-employed architect, professional fees credited to bank account.
The villa market value is around 1.8 crore.
I would prefer an 8 year tenure.

scenarios.name: Loan Cap Exceeded (90L) and Rejected
scenarios.description: Customer requests 90 Lakhs and declines to proceed with the 75 Lakh cap.
customer_utterances: No, 75 lakhs is too low for my requirement, please cancel.

scenarios.name: Tenure Disqualification (2 Years)
scenarios.description: Customer requests a 2-year tenure which is below the 3-year minimum.
customer_utterances: Salaried in MNC, salary in bank account.
I want to close it quickly in just 2 years.

scenarios.name: Tenure Disqualification (20 Years)
scenarios.description: Customer insists on a 20-year tenure which exceeds the 15-year maximum.
customer_utterances: I want a long tenure of 20 years to keep EMI low.

scenarios.name: Busy Customer Reschedule Flow
scenarios.description: Customer is driving and asks for a callback tomorrow morning.
customer_utterances: I am currently driving and busy. Please call me tomorrow morning at 11 am.

scenarios.name: Existing Loan Balance Transfer Intent
scenarios.description: Customer already has a property loan with another bank and wants to reduce EMI / transfer balance.
customer_utterances: Actually, I already have an existing property loan with another bank and I want to reduce my EMI by transferring the balance.

scenarios.name: Compound Answers with Out-of-Order Extraction
scenarios.description: Customer answers multiple checklist items in one utterance, agent adapts without re-asking.
customer_utterances: Look, I am looking for 45 lakhs for 7 years on my sole-owned residential house worth 1 crore. I work in a bank with salaried income credited to account.
Yes, I have all original registry papers in my bank locker.
The market value is 1 crore as I mentioned.

scenarios.name: Correction from Residential to Agricultural
scenarios.description: Customer first says residential but then corrects to agricultural property.
customer_utterances: Well, residential... actually wait, it's strictly agricultural farmland under cultivation.

scenarios.name: Customer Interrupts Asking for Interest Rate
scenarios.description: Customer interrupts to ask about the interest rate before answering, agent answers and resumes flow.
customer_utterances: Before I say yes, what is your interest rate?
Okay fair enough. Yes, I am interested.
Yes, all original documents are with us.
Salaried software architect, bank account transfer.

scenarios.name: Wrong Person / Wrong Number
scenarios.description: Person answering clarifies this is a wrong number.
customer_utterances: No, this is wrong number, Arun doesn't use this number anymore.

scenarios.name: Original Documents Confirmed Lost / Unavailable
scenarios.description: Customer confirms original documents are lost and cannot be produced.
customer_utterances: No, unfortunately the original property documents are lost and unavailable, I only have photocopies.
